ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — MayRequire Content
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: The UNCHANGED mod whose content is gated on joof.testharness.gate, reproducing the two real P4 shapes from the vmemese-removal run: a whole def gated at its root (<ThingDef MayRequire="...">, like the dropped ThingStyleDef) and a patch-injected gated <li MayRequire="..."> (like the FactionDef requiredMemes li). This mod and its files are identical across Run A and Run B; the ONLY change between runs is the gate mod being removed, so any flip here must be driven by Seed 6 (the MayRequire channel). No game content — dev/QA use only.
